 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Afghanistan and Zimbabwe meet at Sharjah Cricket Stadium on Thursday 29 October, with the second of three T20Is starting at 8:00 PM IST.
 Afghanistan lead the series 1-0 after winning the opener by 37 runs, a result that stretched their T20I record against Zimbabwe to 20 wins from 22 meetings and made it six straight victories over them.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Zimbabwe have to level the series to keep it alive for the decider. They will again be without the injured Blessing Muzarabani, whose place went to debutant Ernest Masuku in the first game. The surface stayed slow through Tuesday's match, so spin could again matter in the second innings.
 Afghanistan vs. Zimbabwe 2nd T2OI prediction: Who will win?
 Afghanistan have won six straight T20Is against Zimbabwe and lead the head-to-head 20-2. Even when their top order slid to 66 for 5 on Tuesday, the lower order rescued them through Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai and Rashid Khan. Then Fazalhaq Farooqi and Rashid squeezed Zimbabwe on a slow, grippy surface. Zimbabwe's batters lost wickets in clusters through the middle overs and never found a rhythm
 TSN Prediction : Afghanistan to win.
